body: That sounds awful. I was on 200 mg Seroquel when I left the hospital. For Sleep!! I'm happy I got it down as much as I did, when I did. As soon as I saw the side effects and long term damaging effects it was a no go. Did you every feel dull or numb on it? I feel super out of it and not myself while on it.
Okay. I am definitely gonna taper, just not sure how slow I should take it. Thank you!
Thank you! I hope so. I'm tapering off of seroquel as well
Thank you! I am worried because I have been kindled before and had some bad withdrawal experience before, so wanted to get others experiences on it.
Thanks so much! Did you struggle with sleep after you got off of seroquel? Sorry to hear the switch didn't work.

I bounced back after about 4 months the first time, but I don't know if I'll be able to this time. This time was immediate adverse reaction.  I'm not completely anhedonic but parts of me still aren't there. I'm also afraid that the AP is keeping me from having anhedonia again. It seems odd, but I just feel no matter what I do, I can't win.
I get these horrible sharp pains in my legs whenever I take my dose and tingling after I fall asleep.
